description: Free, no payment. Checks a password against Have I Been Pwned's Pwned Passwords using k-anonymity. Never send the password: send `sha1_prefix` (the first 5 hex characters of its SHA-1) and compare the returned suffixes yourself, or send `sha1` (the full 40-character hash) and get a yes/no. Hashes are not stored. Next step (paid): Stop passwords and keys leaking in the first place: Privacy Guard checks text before your agent posts it.

sha1.description: The full SHA-1 hash, 40 hex characters

sha1_prefix.description: First 5 hex characters of the password's SHA-1 (safest)

name: password_check_check
title: Leaked Password Check: Look up a password hash among leaked passwords
